questions.q: According to Herzberg, which of these is a hygiene factor?
questions.why: Herzberg saw pay as a hygiene factor: poor pay causes dissatisfaction but more pay does not motivate in itself.

questions.q: A worker is given tasks that need more skill and responsibility. This is called:
questions.why: Enrichment adds challenge/responsibility; enlargement adds tasks at the same level.

questions.q: Which of these is a non-financial reward?
questions.why: A company car is a fringe benefit (non-financial); the others are paid as money.

questions.q: Explain one disadvantage to a business of paying factory workers by piece rate.
questions.model: Workers may rush to produce as many units as possible, so quality falls and more products are wasted or rejected.
